title: from_credentials and from_content use different bcrypt validators
description: from_credentials uses parse_bcrypt_cost() to validate passwords (no length check); from_content uses looks_like_bcrypt_hash() (length check + cost check). These are inconsistent. A reader expecting uniform validation behaviour across both constructors will be confused. Suggested fix: change from_credentials to use looks_like_bcrypt_hash() in its guard. This removes the inconsistency, tightens the validation contract, and makes the doc comment accurate without changing runtime behaviour on any real bcrypt hash (which is always >= 60 chars).
